utterances.speaker: arjun
utterances.text: Let's keep this quick. Neha, where are we on the Q3 campaign deck?

utterances.speaker: neha
utterances.text: Draft is 80% done. I'll send it to Arjun for review by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: arjun
utterances.text: Good. Also, remind me -- I told Raghav I'd send him the updated vendor list. I'll get that to him by end of day tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: raghav
utterances.text: Appreciated. Separately, the Mumbai office renewal paperwork needs someone to sign off this week. Not sure whose desk that's on right now.

utterances.speaker: divya
utterances.text: I think that's supposed to be Facilities, but I haven't seen anyone pick it up.

utterances.speaker: arjun
utterances.text: Okay, flag it, don't assume. Divya, can you also pull the July expense variance report before Thursday's board prep?

utterances.speaker: divya
utterances.text: Yes, I'll have it ready Wednesday evening.

utterances.speaker: arjun
utterances.text: One more thing -- client call with Meridian Logistics got pushed. I need to reconfirm the new time with their team myself.

utterances.speaker: neha
utterances.text: Also, just a reminder, the campaign deck review -- I said Wednesday, but realistically Thursday morning is safer.
